Source: @jebheheslahat

❇️ Spokesman of the Iran Reform Front: Preventing war must be the decision-makers' first red line 🔺Javad Imam, spokesman of the Iran Reform Front, warning of the danger of war against Iran, emphasized: Preventing war must be the country's decision-makers' first "red line," and every avenue of negotiation, diplomacy, and de-escalation must be exhausted to the very last possibility.◾️The spokesman of the Iran Reform Front wrote in a post on the X social network: "The danger of war against Iran must not be underestimated; preventing war must be the decision-makers' first red line."◾️Noting that it is the decision-makers who decide to start or enter a war, but the people who pay its costs, he added: "If war breaks out, it is the people who pay its price with their lives, security, homes, and livelihood."◾️The spokesman of the Iran Reform Front, stating that "no political, security, or military calculation should take precedence over people's lives," emphasized: "Before any irreversible decision, every avenue of negotiation, diplomacy, and de-escalation must be tested to the very last possibility."◾️Javad Imam continued, clarifying that although it is America and Israel who would start the war, he noted: "The responsibility for preventing its expansion and the cost of ending it cannot be ignored; it is the people who pay the price of war."◾️In conclusion, emphasizing the position of "No to war," he deemed it essential to prioritize the preservation of people's lives and security and to use diplomatic capacities to prevent the expansion of the conflict.🔹The Iran Reform Front's address on social networks: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)

❇️ Election of the members of the Presiding Board of the Iran Reform Front for the second year of the third term🔺 At today's meeting of the General Assembly of the Iran Reform Front, five members of the Front's Presiding Board were elected for the second year of its third term.▪️ According to the results of this election, Azar Mansouri, Mohsen Armin, Seyed Hassan Rasouli, Badrosadat Mofidi, and Javad Imam were elected as President, First Vice President, Second Vice President, Secretary, and Spokesperson of the Iran Reform Front, respectively.▪️ The Presiding Board of the Iran Reform Front is composed of 10 members, five of whom — the President, two Vice Presidents, the Secretary, and the Spokesperson — are elected directly by the General Assembly.▪️ The other five members of the Presiding Board are the heads of the Front's five committees, who will join the Presiding Board after being elected by the members of the committees.️ ◾️It should be noted that all five elected by the General Assembly held these same positions in the first year of the third term as well, and the General Assembly of the Iran Reform Front once again expressed its trust in them through its vote.🔹The Iran Reform Front's addresses on social networks: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)

entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @jebheheslahat

❇️ Summoning of the Secretary of the Iran Reform Front to the Security Prosecutor's Office

🔺 Badr al-Sadat Mofidi, Secretary of the Iran Reform Front, appeared today at Branch 2 of the Security Prosecutor's Office of District 33, and after interrogation and presentation of final defenses, was released on bail.

◾️ The summoning of the Secretary of the Iran Reform Front comes as part of the ongoing process of summoning and filing cases against members of the Front's Board of Directors. This case concerns the Iran Reform Front's statement about the catastrophe of 18 and 19 Dey, which was published in Bahman of last year.

◾️ In that statement, the Iran Reform Front, while expressing sympathy and solidarity with the grieving people of Iran, emphasized the need for fundamental, urgent, and serious changes and a reconsideration of past approaches, and declared that reformist efforts to have reforms recognized as part of the solution have reached a dead end.

◾️ The formation of an independent fact-finding committee to investigate the various dimensions of this catastrophe, as well as the formation of a national assembly bringing together all elites and concerned citizens of the country to find ways out of the existing crises, were among the proposals put forward in this statement.

◾️ The issuance of this statement was met with a reaction from security and judicial bodies and the summoning of a number of members of the Board of Directors of the Iran Reform Front — a process that continues with the summoning of the Front's Secretary.

🔹The Iran Reform Front's address on social networks: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)
